visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with an unnaturally enlarged head stands in a clean, modern indoor hallway. She wears a sparkling silver sequined halter top, a distressed light-blue denim mini-skirt with a frayed hem, and dark burgundy lace-up combat boots. Her hands are placed casually inside her skirt pockets as she gazes towards the side with an exaggeratedly wide mouth. The setting features a white-tiled planter box filled with brown mulch and a wooden door frame, illuminated by bright, even indoor lighting. (2) The scene cuts to the same woman, still with the big-head effect, standing against a wall made of light-colored, irregular stone tiles. She is now dressed in a sleeveless, pale-yellow mini dress with a drawstring waist and bright red ballet flats. She holds a smartphone in a pink protective case with both hands, smiling and laughing towards someone off-camera. The lighting remains bright, casting soft shadows on the textured wall behind her. (3) The woman appears in a new ensemble, wearing a tan ribbed tank top paired with bold leopard-print trousers and red flats. She has a leopard-print headscarf tied over her hair and wears oversized dark sunglasses. She holds a classic Gucci Boston-style handbag featuring the brand's signature pattern and a white decorative charm. She stands in front of a dark wood-paneled door, maintaining a neutral but stylish posture. (4) The scene shifts to the woman wearing a minimalist black strapless crop top and dark charcoal grey wide-leg trousers. She holds a unique, crescent-shaped metallic gold handbag by its top handle. The background consists of a bamboo screen wall and a large green-leafed plant in a pot, creating a natural, serene indoor atmosphere. Her expression is focused as she slightly tilts her head. (5) A young man with an enlarged head replaces the woman in the frame, standing in the same white-walled hallway with the planter box seen earlier. He is wearing a beige, short-sleeved open-knit mesh shirt over a white undershirt and light-wash denim shorts. He begins a playful, high-energy dance, swaying his hips and extending his arms outward with a surprised facial expression. The lighting is bright and consistent with previous phases.
